description: This file defines a 'Request' struct that wraps an HTTP request, providing convenience methods for accessing request parameters, headers, body content, and route information within the 'go-restful' framework.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: A wrapper around http.Request providing methods for parameter, header, body, and route handling.

methods.name: NewRequest
methods.description: Creates a new Request wrapper around an http.Request.

methods.name: PathParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a path parameter by name.

methods.name: QueryParameter
methods.description: Retrieves the first value of a query parameter by name.

methods.name: QueryParameters
methods.description: Returns all values of a query parameter by name.

methods.name: BodyParameter
methods.description: Parses the request body and returns the value of a specified parameter.

methods.name: HeaderParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a header value by name.

methods.name: ReadEntity
methods.description: Reads and unmarshals the request body into an entity, handling decompression if needed.
